account.title: Account
account.name: Full name
account.emailHint: Contact C2B to change the email you sign in with.
account.languageHint: Used for the interface and your notifications.

password.title: Password
password.text: Use at least 8 characters with a letter and a number.
password.googleText: You sign in with Google. You can also set a password to sign in with your email.
password.currentGoogleHint: Leave empty if you have never set a password.
password.superAdmin: This is the main C2B admin account. Its password is set in the server settings (Render): change SEED_ADMIN_PASSWORD there and it applies after the server restarts.

admins.title: C2B administrators
admins.text: People who can approve organizations, review pathways and manage the catalogue.
admins.newText: Share the temporary password securely; they can change it in Settings.
admins.deleteText: {{name}} will lose access immediately and their account will be permanently deleted.

delete.title: Delete account
delete.text: Permanently delete your C2B account and the data that belongs to it.

warnings.permanent: This cannot be undone. You will be signed out straight away.
warnings.learner: Your profile, CV, learning pathways and enrollments will be deleted.
warnings.orgAdmin: {{name}} will be deleted too. Its invite links stop working and its employees keep their accounts as individual learners.
warnings.admin: If you are the last active C2B administrator, you cannot delete your account.

delete.superAdmin: This is the main C2B admin account, so it can’t be deleted. Its email and password are managed in the server settings (Render).
